title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-04
source: sbd > ?? > wav > audacity(snaps,crackles,pops) > wavmerge > cdwav > tlh(flaclevel8) > flac16

ai_review.summary: Sweet Jerry vocals and a standout Black Peter make this acoustic set shine, captured on an excellent mono soundboard tape despite a missing opening track.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the acoustic performance, highlighting Jerry Garcia’s unusually sweet voice and praising Black Peter as a high point. The recording is described as exceptional – clear and well‑balanced – though one note mentions that this mono version omits the first song and has a cut in “Swing Low.” Overall the show and its capture are received very positively.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both performance (sweet vocals, strong Black Peter) and audio quality (exceptional sound), with only minor technical omissions lowering the score slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear acoustic mix with sweet vocal presence; mono tape taken from a taper's section, missing the opening song and containing a cut in "Swing Low" but otherwise crisp.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The acoustic set flows smoothly, showcasing tight playing and especially sweet vocal delivery; no major performance flaws were noted.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note his voice is unusually sweet and lovely in this session.
